title: Graph covers, shadow intersections, and incidence geometries

targets.name: Theorem A
targets.claim: Geometry iff typed monodromy-coset Helly; under that condition, residual connectedness iff common-shadow monodromy equals the intersection of individual shadow monodromies.
assumptions: finite-rank residually connected base geometry, rank at least three
B1 simple vertex-edge graph and B2 endpoint-shadow edge incidence
connected regular graph cover with deck action free and transitive on each fiber
higher objects lift to connected components of their shadow covers
for bipartite compression, a chosen bipartition of the cover

targets.name: Panel transfer
targets.claim: Firmness and thinness are preserved in both directions once the output is a geometry.

targets.name: Optional group-action transfer
targets.claim: Chamber transitivity lifts when every given base automorphism lifts to the cover; compressed statement additionally assumes nonbipartite base graph.

targets.name: Parity specialization
targets.claim: For canonical all-edges-odd C2 voltage cover, Helly is automatic and monodromy equality is exactly phase27 PC; no claim for arbitrary C2-cover bipartiteness.

retained_foundations: Standard graph covering definitions and classical voltage/coset correspondence; all needed walk-lifting and incidence arguments proved in the note.
